issues: Caption: The caption and slide 3 say Punjab 2022 was won under "isi EC" or "isi Election Commission". Gyanesh Kumar became CEC in Feb 2025, so he was not CEC for the 2022 Punjab election or the Feb 2025 Delhi election. It is the same institution but a different CEC.
